name: little-snitch
description: Read and change the Little Snitch firewall on a Mac, with every change approved in the macOS administrator dialog.

allow.title: Changes the assistant may make
allow.description: Leave empty to only read. Otherwise a comma-separated list of: switches (profiles and rule groups), rules (add, change, remove), restore (restore a backup), or all. Each change still needs your approval in the macOS administrator dialog.
